Game Overview

Santa Bomber 3D is a strategy title where join Santa in a festive 3D adventure. Strategically place bombs to clear ghostly obstacles and deliver gifts without getting caught in your own explosions. With dynamic levels and immersive graphics, Santa Bomber 3D is a thrilling blend of strategy and holiday cheer.
